column1: # tests/corpus/manifest.tsv -- canonical hash-pinned guest artifact manifest.
# Storage rule: this repository stores guest METADATA (URLs, versions, SHA-256,
# sizes, licenses), never the downloaded bytes. Guests are fetched on demand
# SHA-256-verified before extraction or execution. Never track guest
# binaries, installers, archives, or extracted trees in Git.
#   id                      unique guest id (used by scripts/fetch_guest.sh)
#   source_url              direct download URL (official upstream when possible)
#   filename                file name stored in the cache
#   sha256                  pinned SHA-256 of the exact artifact
#   size_bytes              exact artifact size in bytes
#   redistribution_notes    acquisition constraints and status flags
#   extraction_subdirectory top-level dir created on extraction ("." = flat)
#   launch_target           guest exe path relative to the extraction root
#   VERIFIED        URL reachable and hash pinned from the actual artifact
#   UNVERIFIED_URL  hash pinned from a previously measured artifact; exact
#                   download URL not re-verifiable today -- fetch_guest
#                   refuses any off-manifest substitute until re-pinned
#   SEED            no legitimate public download exists (Microsoft Windows
#                   XP system binaries). Acquire from your own licensed XP
#                   media into the local seed dir (docs/GUEST_ARTIFACTS.md);
#                   fetch_guest verifies the pinned SHA-256 before any use.
#   BLOCKED         download currently unavailable; do not fake a substitute
